To praise, extol, approve of; साधु साध्विति भूतानि शशंसुर्मारुतात्मजम्
 Rām.; संन्यासं कर्मणां कृष्ण पुनर्योगं च शंससि

To tell, relate, express, declare, communicate, announce, report (with
 dat. or sometimes gen. of person or by itself); शशंस सीतापरिदेवनान्तमनुष्ठितं
 शासनमग्रजाय

to indicate, bespeak, show; यः (अशोकः) सावज्ञो माधवश्रीनियोगे
 पुष्पैः शंसत्यादरं त्वत्प्रयत्ने
To repeat, recite; ओमिति शंसति Ch.

To praise in ऋक् verse not
[]
 set to music (as distinguished from स्तु €2 U.); प्रगीतेषु मन्त्रवाक्येषु
 स्तौतिशब्दः अप्रगीतेषु शंसतिशब्दः ŚB. on
Conjecture, belief; मातास्य युगपद् वाक्यं विप्रियं प्रियशंसया
Sharpened, aroused; ततस्ते सूदिताः सर्वे मम बाणाः सुसंशिताः

Firmly adhering to (a vow); उपोष्य संशितो भूत्वा हित्वा वेदकृताः
 श्रुतीः

Telling, announcing, communicating; प्रजावती
[]
 दोहदशंसिनी ते
Presaging, foretelling; बभूव सर्वं शुभशंसि तत्क्षणम्

A warrior sworn never to recede from a contest and kept to
[]
 prevent the flight of others; संशप्तकान्निहतानर्जुनेन तदा नाशंसे
 विजयाय संजय
A conspirator who has taken an oath to kill another.
To be allayed or extinguished, disappear; सत्त्वं संशाम्यतीव मे
To settle, decide; बुद्ध्या संशमयन्ति नीतिकुशलाः साम्नैव ते मन्त्रिणः
Commencement of a combat, attack, charge.
The world, worldly life, mundane existence; पुंसो भवेद्यर्हि संसरणापवर्गः
A resting-place for passengers near the gates of a city.
+ -आत्मन् a. one whose mind is thoroughly matured or disciplined.
+ -व्रत a. one who has fulfilled his vow.

To waver, be in doubt or suspense, be uncertain or irresolute; संशय्य
 कर्णादिषु तिष्ठते यः
To lie down for rest, sleep.

Doubt, uncertainty, irresolution, hesitation; मनस्तु मे संशयमेव
 गाहते

Doubt or indecision (in Nyāya), one of the 16 categories mentioned
 in the Nyāya philosophy; एकधर्मिकविरुद्धभावाभावप्रकारकं ज्ञानं
 संशयः; it is also regarded as one of the two kinds of अयथार्थज्ञान.
Danger, peril, risk; न संशयमनारुह्य नरो भद्राणि पश्यति

A subject of dispute or controversy; अग्निहोत्रादहमभ्यागताऽस्मि विप्रर्षभाणां
 संशयच्छेदनाय

.
.━{@Comp.@}: संशयाक्षेपः, संशयात्मन्, संशयापन्न, संशयोपेत, संशयस्थ, संशयोपमा, संशयगत, संशयच्छेदः, संशयच्छेदिन्

+ -आक्षेपः a particular figure of speech (‘removal of doubt’); किमयं
 शरदम्भोदः किंवा हंसकदम्बकम् । रुतं नूपुरसंवादि श्रूयते तन्न
 तोयदः ॥ इत्ययं संशयाक्षेपः संशयो यन्निवार्यते ।

+ -उपमा a comparison expressed in the form of a doubt; किं पद्ममन्तर्भ्रान्तालि
 किं ते लोलेक्षणं मुखम् । मम दोलायते चित्तमितीयं संशयोपमा ॥
+ -छेदिन् a. clearing all doubt, decisive; Ś. 3.

संशयान, संशयालु, संशयितृ a. Doubtful, irresolute,
 uncertain, wavering.

 uncertain, wavering.

 ते शरीरावस्था
Doubt; न हि मे संशीतिरस्या दिव्यतां प्रति
To clear, secure (a road against attack); संशोध्य त्रिविधं मार्गम्
Searched, tried, examined; वेषाभरणसंशुद्धाः स्पृशेयुः सुसमाहिताः
To have recourse to, resort, fly to for refuge or shelter.
To lean or rest on, depend on; न खलु बहिरुपाधीन् प्रीतयः संश्रयन्ते
To obtain; संश्रयत्येव तच्छीलं नरोऽल्पमपि वा बहु

A resting or dwelling place, residence, habitation; त्वं सदा संश्रयः
 शैल स्वर्गमार्गाभिकाङ्क्षिणाम्

Seeking protection or shelter with, fleeing for refuge, forming or
 seeking alliance, leaguing together for mutual protection; one of the 6
 guṇas or expedients in politics; see under गुण also; संश्रयवृत्तिः
 Kau.

Attachment (for home, relatives &c.); तथा प्रयत्नं कुर्वीत यथा
 मुच्येत संश्रयात्

A piece or portion belonging to anything.

United, joined; चूतेन संश्रितवती नवमालिकेयम् Ś. 4. 13.
To listen to; संशृणोति न चोक्तानि

; द्विजस्य संश्रुतोऽर्थो मे जीवयिष्यामि ते सुतम्
To join, unite. ━Caus. To unite, join, connect together.
Clasped or pressed together, joined, united.
Adjoining, lying close or contiguous to.

Related, connected together; यथा छायातपौ नित्यं सुसंबद्धौ परस्परम् ।
 एवं कर्म च कर्ता च संश्लिष्टावितरेतरम् ॥

Embracing; an embrace; वशिनां हि परपरिग्रहसंश्लेषपराङ्मुखी

Pass. To be attached or connected together, be joined

Adhering or clinging to, attached to, sticking close to.
Joined or linked together, closely connected; प्रान्तेषु संसक्तनमेरुशाखम्
+ -चेतस्, -मनस् a. having the mind fixed or attached.
+ -चेतस्, -मनस् a. having the mind fixed or attached.

Hesitating, stammering (through sorrow); (उवाच) वाङ्मात्रेण न

 महोदयानाम्

Intercourse, intimacy, intimate acquaintance; संसक्तिं मृशमपि
 भूरिशोऽवधूतैः Śi. 8. 67.
To sit down; sit down together.
To be afflicted, be in distress.
An assembly, meeting, circle; संसत्सु जाते पुरुषाधिकारे
A court of justice; अपह्नवेऽधमर्णस्य देहीत्युक्तस्य संसदि
To accomplish, complete; सर्वान् संसाधयेदर्थानक्षिण्वन् योगतस्तनुम्

To attain supreme felicity, to become happy; जप्येनैव तु संसिध्येत्
 ब्राह्मणो नात्र संशयः
One who has secured final emancipation.
+ -अर्थ a. one who has attained his goal.

 धर्मस्य संसिद्धिर्हरितोषणम्

Nature, natural disposition, state or quality.
p. p. Perfectly delighted or gratified.

; or परिवर्तिनि संसारे मृतः को वा

.

an epithet of the god of love.

the course of worldly affairs, worldly life.
the course of worldly affairs, worldly life.

+ -मोक्षः, -मोक्षणम् final liberation or emancipation from worldly life.

 and अत्यन्ताभाव absolute, non-existence.

 especially with bad people.
Keeping company with, familiar. ━m. An associate, a companion.
Commingled, mixed or united together, conjoined.
Associated or connected together as partners.

(In law) Voluntary reunion in pecuniary interest of kinsmen (as of

Living in one family; see संसृष्टता (2) above.

 स्थितिः संसृष्टिरुच्यते S.

[]
 or guṇas recognised by the Vaiśeṣikas; it is of three kinds: भावना,
 वेग, and स्थितिस्थापकता qq. vv.

; (Manu mentions 12 such Saṃskāras viz. 1 गर्भाधान,

A rite or ceremony in general.
